analysis.previewPipeline: M3PreviewCanvas.jsx -> MediaFactoryRenderer.jsx -> VisualizerRenderer.jsx (React DOM component rendering via WebGL/Canvas2D in browser DOM)
analysis.exportPipeline: FFmpegFrameProvider.js -> RenderScheduler.js -> CanvasKitRenderer.js (WASM Skia standalone rasterizer)

divergencePoints.issue: Preview relies on React DOM component <VisualizerRenderer /> to mount browser Canvas2D/WebGL plugins. In offline/headless export (FFmpeg), React DOM components are NOT rendered.
divergencePoints.impact: The visualizer React DOM element is never captured during export.

divergencePoints.issue: FFmpegFrameProvider and RenderScheduler invoke CanvasKitRenderer.renderFrame() as a standalone function with empty visualizerConfig {}. It does NOT composite background/foreground layers from ProjectModel or RenderPipeline.
divergencePoints.impact: CanvasKitRenderer generates a standalone visualizer image on a solid dark #111216 background, completely disconnected from the multi-layer composition pipeline.

divergencePoints.issue: CanvasKitDrawVisualizer.js ONLY implements shape === 'bar'. If a project specifies any other visualizer shape (e.g. 'circle', 'wave', 'line', or plugin ID 'bars-classic-vertical'), CanvasKitDrawVisualizer silently skips rendering.
divergencePoints.impact: CanvasKitDrawVisualizer produces 0 bars for all non-bar shapes.

divergencePoints.issue: RenderScheduler.requestFrame() takes only (targetFrameIndex, overrideOptions). It does NOT receive or pass ProjectModel scene objects, layer lists, enabled flags, or real audio FFT data.
divergencePoints.impact: Renderer has no awareness of timeline layers or real audio spectrum.
